question: In a cyclotron, a charged particle of mass $m$ and charge $q$ moves in a circular path under a uniform magnetic field $B$. Obtain expressions for the maximum speed and maximum kinetic energy of the particle when the maximum radius of its path is $R$. Calculate the maximum kinetic energy of a proton for $B=0.60\text{ T}$ and $R=0.50\text{ m}$. Given $q=1.6\times10^{-19}\text{ C}$ and $m=1.67\times10^{-27}\text{ kg}$.
